results.scenario: The owner Ada North authenticates via Auth0 password grant and successfully moves 2500 GBP minor units from the seeded operating account to the tax reserve account using the MCP create_transfer tool, then verifies through list_accounts that the source balance decreased by exactly the transferred amount and the destination balance increased by exactly the transferred amount. The scenario also reads Postgres directly to confirm that exactly two ledger entries were posted (one transfer_out on the source account and one transfer_in on the destination account) sharing the returned transferGroupId, both with the correct amount, currency, organization, counterparty references, and unique per-run description. Finally, it verifies that the persisted account balances in the database match the balances returned in the list_accounts response, proving the API response reflects committed state rather than a computed view. All balance assertions are deltas relative to the pre-transfer balances captured in step 1, making the flow repeatable and parallel-safe against shared seeded accounts.

stepsValidation.description: Mint Ada North owner access token via Auth0 password grant
List accounts before transfer to capture pre-move balances
Move money from operating to tax reserve
List accounts after transfer and verify the balance changes
Read Postgres directly to verify the ledger pair was posted
Read Postgres directly to verify the response reflects committed state
